description_for_human: AgentAudit - Visual Decision Trajectory & Compliance Reporting tool for AI agents. Parse logs from LangChain, AutoGPT, and custom agents to generate visual audit trails and compliance reports. All processing happens locally in your browser.
description_for_model: AgentAudit is a specialized utility for parsing Agentic workflows. It identifies Thought-Action-Observation loops to create a visual audit trail. It is designed for developers auditing LLM behavior and governance teams ensuring AI safety. Key features include: visual trajectory mapping, automated risk detection for keywords like error, failed, unauthorized, refused, local PDF generation, and privacy-first processing. Supported formats: LangChain logs, AutoGPT traces, LlamaIndex logs, custom agent logs in JSON or plain text format.

capabilities.name: parse_agent_logs
capabilities.description: Parse raw agent execution logs to extract Thought-Action-Observation sequences

capabilities.name: generate_audit_trail
capabilities.description: Generate visual decision trajectory from parsed agent logs

capabilities.name: detect_risk_nodes
capabilities.description: Identify risk indicators (error, failed, unauthorized, refused) in agent logs

capabilities.name: export_pdf_report
capabilities.description: Export professional compliance PDF report with verification timestamp
